title: S8 asset and lifecycle field traceability
test_intent: Determine whether governed lifecycle data fields and their carriers can be traced to a declared lifecycle purpose, governed schema definition, source/responsibility and validation route without relying on undocumented field semantics or mappings.

applicability.applies_when: A project or deliverable contains governed asset or lifecycle information intended for operations, maintenance, facility management, handover or another declared downstream lifecycle use.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No governed lifecycle information is required or claimed in the tested scope.

required_evidence: field-definition records for required lifecycle fields
carrier/mapping records where information is transported between systems or containers

result_logic.pass: Every governed lifecycle field in scope has a traceable semantic definition, lifecycle-purpose basis, source/responsibility and applicable carrier/mapping and validation reference.
result_logic.fail: Lifecycle information is asserted as governed while one or more required fields use undocumented semantics, untraceable source/responsibility, uncontrolled requiredness, or an undocumented carrier/mapping that prevents reliable interpretation or validation.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed asset/lifecycle information is required or claimed in the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project declares lifecycle information requirements, but the applicable schema, field-definition or carrier/mapping evidence is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Derived from Confluence GAP-S8-03 page 4161550. It tests field-level semantic and mapping traceability, complementing the existing S7 test for schema/version reference.
